## MiniMax H3 Workflow for Radiance:

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)
- Huggingface: [MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3)
- Github: [MiniMax-H3](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3) ([prompting skills](https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/skills))

## MiniMax H3 Prompting Tips

1. **Look first**: style, light, lens and grade open the prompt  
2. **Then the scene**: what happens, shot by shot or with time marks ([0s-2s] …)  
3. **Audio**: describe dialogue, sound effects and music in the same block

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) (used, Loader preset "MiniMax H3 (Low VRAM)")
- [minimax_h3_fl2va_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_bf16.safetensors) (alternative, preset "MiniMax H3": full precision, larger than 32 GB of VRAM)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) (used)
- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_bf16.safetensors) (alternative, preset "MiniMax H3")

**loras**

- [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.1_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.1_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) (optional, "Turbo LoRA", bypassed by default)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors) (used)

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2va_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.1_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 vae/
│       ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│       └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Note: First and Last Frame
widgets_values:
**First and Last Frame** (optional: select a group, then Ctrl+B):  
- Both off: Text to Video. "First Frame" on: Image to Video. Both on: the shot goes from one image to the other. "Last Frame" alone: the shot ends on it.  
- The "Prompt" shows the images to MiniMax's text encoder: keep "text_to_video" on and describe the whole scene.

widgets_values: a beautiful young woman with auburn hair in a braided updo, all of her hair pinned up, light freckles across her nose, cheeks slightly reddened by the cold, blue-grey eyes, wearing a white knitted wool sweater, on a cold winter night, looking directly into the lens. Her skin shows fine pores and soft peach fuzz. She is riding a carousel at a night fair. Behind her, the fairground lamps are so far out of focus that they become huge, round bokeh discs in red, orange, yellow, pink and violet, filling the whole background. A few tiny snowflakes float in the air in front of her and sparkle in the colored light of the lamps. The scene tone is warm and dreamlike.

From the very first frame, the ride carries her and the camera steadily around together, so she stays still in the frame while the whole blurred background behind her keeps sliding past from the right edge of the frame to the left edge, without stopping until the end of the shot. She sways gently with the motion of the ride, and the cold air of the ride lifts a few loose strands of hair around her face. The soft creak of the turning carousel and distant fairground voices can be heard from the start, and they continue under her voice until the end of the shot. The colored light of the passing lamps washes over her face in colored waves, tinting it red. She begins to speak directly to the camera in a warm voice, her lips and jaw moving clearly with every word: 'Hey! Let's create some wonderful glowing scenes on MiniMax H3 with Radiance!' A puff of breath vapor leaves her mouth with each word and catches the colored light. After the last word, she closes her lips into a small, gentle smile and holds it, still looking into the lens, while the background keeps sliding past behind her from right to left.

nodes.title: Note: Outputs
widgets_values:
**Outputs**:  
- The EXR sequence is the HDR master (scene-linear Rec.709, 1.0 = 203 nits);  
- The sound is saved beside it as a WAV, lined up with the frames' timecode.  
- The MP4 Writes are bypassed by default: select one and press Ctrl+B to enable it.  
Watch the PQ MP4 on an HDR display (mrv2, DaVinci Resolve); the SDR MP4 plays anywhere.

nodes.title: Note: Viewer
widgets_values:
**Viewer**:  
- A long 1080p shot does not fit in the Viewer's 2 GB cache, so the Viewer runs again on every queue. Bypass it when you don't need it.

nodes.title: Note: Turbo LoRA
widgets_values:
**Turbo LoRA** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):  
- lightx2v's distilled LoRA: the "Sampler", in "Auto", sees it and runs 8 steps instead of 20, about 2.3× faster.  
- Keep the model's own shift and the "Auto" sampler: they gave the most natural skin in our tests.  
- Trained at 768p: above it, compare with the full 20 steps.

nodes.title: Note: AI Fill
widgets_values:
**AI Fill** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):
- Draws the inside of fully clipped highlights (sun, lamps, a white sky) that "SDR → HDR Universal" leaves flat, and sets their brightness (up to 3 stops above the master).
- Plausible, not recovered. The SDR view does not change: only the HDR master gains detail. With nothing clipped, it changes nothing.
- First run: downloads about 8 GB into models/radiance (RUDRA AI fill v3 and Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B). Needs about 16 GB of VRAM.
- "prompt_highlight": what to draw (e.g. "soft clouds in a bright blue sky"). Empty uses RUDRA's own prompt; a custom one loads an 11 GB text encoder once.
- Video: the frames go through in overlapping 33-frame windows, so a long shot takes a while.
